items.text: Hey Madden fans!

Welcome back to our Madden NFL 27 Gridiron Notes, your source for all news and updates straight from our developer team. Most Feared Season is here already and so is our latest Title Update. We have a lot of information to share with you today so let's get started.
Added 4 New Celebration Animations exclusively for Aaron Rodgers

Dev Note: Last month, we invited Rodgers Realm to come in and collaborate with our motion capture team in the studio to exclusively record celebration animations. These are now available for you to try when you celebrate with Aaron Rodgers in Play Now, Franchise, Ultimate Team, and can be equipped on your Avatar in Superstar. Learn more about it here. **

Fixed an issue with coverage-calls Pounder, Roll Ring, Roll King, and Cover 9 so that Quarters safeties will now appropriately match verticals regardless of the underneath man/match assignments by teammates.
Slightly Tuned the Double or Nothing Ability to be less effective.
Dev Note: This tuning was done to all tiers of the ability.
Fixed an issue where DBs would switch assignments in Combo and Point Combo when the receiver is blocking
Fixed an issue where players in rare situations were auto subbed out during hurry up.
Fixed an issue that allowed users to audible during hurry up without resetting the defensive package.
Tuning to improve AI logic when using Pass Commit vs. HB Double Pass.
Players outside of the tackle box will no longer be targeted with Empty Protection unless manually ID’d.
Defenders ‘Untargeted’ by the User will now be completely ignored.
Lane assignments on kickoff will now flip for teams with left footed kickers.

From the Dev Team: Hey Madden fans! In our last Title Update, we mentioned that additional salary-cap and CPU roster-management fixes were in progress. This update continues that work, alongside fixes to player progression, contracts, and custom roster and Custom Draft Classes. If you want to receive all of the Salary Cap updates that we included in this Title Update, we recommend that players start new Franchise Leagues, all of the additional updates will not require new leagues.

Improved CPU re-signing so teams are less likely to let key players reach free agency, and fixed player-mindset issues that could block negotiations or push a player toward free agency before his team had a chance to re-sign him.
Addressed inflated contract bonuses and CPU handling of large contracts that were contributing to salary-cap problems as leagues progressed.
Teams are less likely to restructure contracts when their roster needs don't call for it.
Fixed an issue that could leave recovered players stuck on a CPU team's injured reserve.
CPU teams will no longer sign non-exclusive franchise-tagged low-value players in free agency.
CPU teams will now cut low-performing players with large cap savings at the start of the offseason.
CPU salary-cap decisions now account for cap space carried over from the previous season.
Corrected salary-cap calculations involving contract incentives when extending, releasing, or trading players.
Corrected restructure calculations on contracts with void years that could let users avoid contract payments.
Improved the consistency of the annual Dynamic Salary Cap adjustment by correcting the financial data used at season rollover.
Fifth-year option money is now applied to guaranteed salary instead of signing bonus.
Fixed an issue where users could offer contracts below the required Franchise, Transition, and Non-Exclusive tag values.
Added the "Next Year's Cap" readout to player extension conversations.
Fixed an issue where, with the Salary Cap turned off, users were unable to offer max contracts, and corrected the over-the-cap warning popup not displaying correctly.
Addressed excessive player progression during multi-season simulation, along with cases where players were retiring too early.
Fixed an issue where CPU players could still show Wear and Tear effects when the setting was turned off.

Hey Madden fans,

In our last Title Update, we shared that we were continuing to work on CPU salary-cap management. This update addresses how the cap changes over the life of a Franchise and how CPU teams make decisions about signings and trades.
We are working on additional fixes that should appear in future updates and will continue to monitor Salary Cap management and CPU roster decisions as it affects Franchise league progress.
Addressed issues affecting Dynamic Salary Cap in Franchise.
The league salary cap is designed to grow as the years progress, alongside changes to player salaries and contracts.
Improved CPU signing and re-signing decisions. Teams now account for a player's fair market value when checking available cap room, and their spending limits vary by contention phase.
Those limits also apply to free-agent pickups during the season.
CPU teams should no longer make trades that create cap penalties above a set percentage of the league salary cap.
Addressed a Field Goal Blocking issue involving looping defenders.
Tuned Wide Receiver Catch Success Rates to improve consistency on throw out of sack situations.
Improved Run Action Block Targeting to detect threats more effectively.
Fixed an issue where the game clock would run off following a delay of game with stopped game clock.
Added Captain Patches to Commanders Uniforms.

From the Dev Team: Hey Madden fans! This Title Update focuses on the areas you've provided feedback on that matter most: online-league stability, free agency realism, contract and retirement logic, and CPU salary-cap behavior. The fixes in today's Title Update will be applied to all existing Franchise Leagues. We will continue to monitor your feedback and tune your experience in future updates. Here is a list of what you can expect for tomorrow!
When you submit the top offer for a free agent, you should now win them far more often.

Dev Note:Players now weigh offers on both best fit and total contract value, and evaluate offers in OVR order during Free Agent Frenzy so the top players sign first. This directly addresses reports of submitting the best offer and still losing the player.

Teams now pursue multiple players at a position of need instead of one at a time, re-evaluating their needs each hour and withdrawing once a need is filled — so CPU teams stop chasing players they no longer need and won't stockpile a pile of signings at a single position.
Negotiation Withdrawals: Added logic to decrement interest and patience when a team withdraws a contract and re-enters a negotiation. You'll also see the player speak to this in the dialogue.
Dev Note: Keep an eye on player interest! If interest was already low, the player can now refuse to continue negotiations entirely.
Adjusted the number of years players ask for in negotiations to cut down on the volume of unrealistic 5+ year deals.
QBs with higher overall ratings are now less likely to retire in their early 30s, and halfbacks are less likely to retire early in their careers.

Fixed contract calculation and display issues, including restructures distributing money incorrectly, Roster Reserve double-counting bonus on draft picks, and the League Transactions log misreporting extensions and restructures.

Reduced how often CPU teams compulsively restructure large contracts, and added logic so CPU teams avoid taking on massive dead-cap hits and won't chase signings that push them too far over next year's cap.
Fixed an issue where fair-market contract values could become overinflated due to a compounding salary-cap multiplier.
Fixed a rare issue where users could be disconnected from the live event in a way that left the entire league inaccessible.
Fixed an issue in online leagues where a user leaving or joining could cause the Gameday tab buttons to disappear for everyone else.
Fixed additional softlocks and script losses around starting and advancing a Franchise.

Dev Note:Stability in online and commissioner leagues is a top priority for us. These fixes target the disconnect-and-lockout scenarios specifically, and we're continuing to harden multi-user leagues in upcoming updates.
Mindset & Dialogue Fixes
Fixed high-level instances where player mindsets would get stuck past when they should, as well as conversation options that would loop infinitely without ending.
Emergent Actions - Fixed an issue where “Wants Contract Extension” Mindset cards stopped appearing in the weekly hub.
Fixed an issue where a user Head Coach could be fired after a winning season that ended in a playoff loss (Wild Card, Divisional, or Conference round).
Fixed an issue where a fired user Head Coach could receive a job offer from the very team that just fired them.
We have a wide range of additional fixes across the News Center, the NFL Draft, settings persistence in multi-user leagues, and general UI, transitions, crashes, and performance.

Dev Note: We're reading your feedback daily. We have some items on our radar, and we are continuing to actively work on them. Stay tuned for a future Title Update Gridiron Notes to know when these are fixed!
CPU Salary-Cap Recovery: We are continuing to work on CPU teams that fall into cap trouble along with other areas of salary cap management within this complex system.
CPU roster depth at specific positions and CPU draft-trade execution during simulated drafts.

From the Dev Team: Hey Madden fans, with tomorrow's Title Update, we’re continuing our focus on improving stability and progression throughout Superstar. We have addressed several issues reported by you around Wear and Tear, Superstar progression, Showdown, the Storefront, Sphere of Influence, and the GOAT Journey.

Fixed an issue where Wear and Tear could accumulate much faster than intended, including instances where players with high Toughness and Stamina could reach severe levels after only a handful of plays.

Addressed several stability issues that could cause players to become stuck or unable to continue, including after importing a Road to Glory player and completing the NFL Combine, selecting Training, or viewing Team Stats after a game.
Improved matchmaking stability, including fixes for a crash when backing out of Ranked Squads matchmaking and an issue where squads could become stuck searching for a game in Play a Friend.

Addressed several Storefront issues, including a server error after a player's first purchase, problems with the Recommended Points purchase flow, and the Superstar Pass not properly loading after returning from a game.
Fixed issues where Influence could be applied to the wrong teammate following depth chart changes and where Play tab quicklinks could open the incorrect SOI quests.
Fixed issues where the Simulation Recap could incorrectly display a GOAT Score of 0 and where Quarterbacks could be forced to retire after four seasons instead of the intended 12-season career.
Additional stability improvements have been made throughout Superstar progression, customization, and menu navigation.

From the Dev Team: With this title update, you’re getting improvements to the Weekly Recap, Halftime Report, broadcast packages, cameras, and various other areas. Thanks to your feedback, we have been able to focus on key areas to improve. Keep it coming!

Addressed several issues that could cause server errors, softlocks, missing eligible players, or blocked actions when filtering, previewing, applying, or removing an Evolution, and when returning from the Auction House. Abilities granted by an Evolution can now be activated correctly in lineups.
Eligibility, requirements, timers, archetype paths, attribute changes, and objective rewards now display more consistently when previewing or removing an Evolution.

Improved the Skill Point and player upgrade flows, including fixes for missing Earn, Exchange, and Buy options, incorrect totals and ratings, empty Upgrade tabs, and issues after exchanging or purchasing Skill Points.

Fixed progression issues after restarting or failing Challenges and after making lineup changes. Also addressed issues with favoriting objectives, incorrect completion states, and a player objective that did not progress during gameplay.

Challenge requirements, bonus star conditions, and completion messaging now display more consistently across pregame, in game, and postgame screens. Also fixed an issue that could return a co-op guest to the Main Menu when the host launched a Challenge the guest had not unlocked.

Fixed an error when opening Field Pass from Event tiles and corrected XP requirements, locked pack states, reward images, and Event progress displays. Reward and Set flows now respond more reliably when viewing, quickselling, or redeeming items.

Fixed an issue that prevented users from creating new lineups. Also corrected OVR Improvements suggestions, Ability and X-Factor status indicators, Chemistry displays, and missing information when comparing players.
Addressed server errors and navigation issues when comparing, buying out, or filtering items, and when returning from the Auction House through an Evolution flow.
Fixed an issue where Draft matchmaking could return players to the Ultimate Team Hub, along with Event Lineup errors and players not defaulting to their primary positions.
Improved Ranked, Squads, and Play a Friend, including fixes for delayed Rank and RP updates, solo matchmaking in Play a Friend Squads, invalid lineup checks, and ready up errors.
Additional stability improvements have been made across pack opening, Events, Field Pass navigation, and Ultimate Team menu flows.
We can't wait for you all to experience this Title Update in Madden NFL 27. Thank you all for your feedback and see you all on the Gridiron!

items.text: Hey Madden fans!

Welcome back to our Madden NFL 27 Gridiron Notes, your source for all news and updates straight from our developer team. Our first major Title Update arrives today, and we wanted to give you a breakdown of what you can expect in today’s update, along with a look ahead at what’s coming in next week’s Title Update! Let's get started!
Hey Madden fans! We’re excited to bring the heat to your next matchup with the new 2026 NFL x Nike Rivalries uniform collection! Check out these amazing rivalry threads for the following teams:
Chicago Bears
Indianapolis Colts
Jacksonville Jaguars
Detroit Lions
Green Bay Packers
Houston Texans
Tennessee Titans
Minnesota Vikings

Outside of stability improvements, there are no gameplay changes in this title update. Next week, we will have a smaller title update focused specifically on gameplay coming your way so stay tuned for that. Here is a quick preview of what you can expect:
Receivers jumping in situations they don't need to.
More holding calls when using Aggressive Blocking coach adjustment.
Defense now flips with offense when auto flip coach adjustment is On (I.e. A slot DB will auto follow a slot WR when formation is flipped when Auto Flip is ON)
Blockers respond better to contain rushers.

Resolved an issue where CPU teams suffered excessive early game injuries due to an issue which multiplied their Wear & Tear accumulation at a higher rate than intended and prevented them from managing weekly practice loads.
Dev Note: CPU teams should now effectively manage wear and tear (pads, reps, and rest) significantly improving overall roster health.
College Coach abilities were not being unlocked with College Coach Archetype.

Dev Note: We have solved this issue with newly created Franchise leagues but it will not unlock the abilities for the coaches that were previously created. Keep in mind that these abilities are only for the Head Coach. Here is the list of abilities exclusive to the College Coach archetype:
Campus Conditioning
Coach's Curriculum
Familiar Landscape
Drill Efficiency
New School
Power Program
Fixed an issue where created players were disappearing after a game was played after importing a custom roster file to start a league.
Dev Note: To apply this fix, you must start a new Franchise league and re-import your custom roster file during initial setup.
Fixed an issue where the value of Void Years weren’t being applied when a contract expired.
Dev Note: After investigating, we found an issue where void years would essentially count the final year's cap hit and not accelerate forward the void year hits.

The team is actively investigating community-feedback regarding roster management, free agency logic, salary cap progression, and CPU decision making. We are committed to addressing these issues and will provide updates in future Gridiron Notes or directly via @MaddenNFLDirect when these issues are resolved. Here is the current list of some key issues we are looking into:

A temporary fix was implemented last week to alleviate an issue some players were experiencing in Multi-User Franchise Leagues. The team is now targeting a full fix to restore Weekly Recap to arrive next week.
Players are retiring at unexpected or illogical points in their careers.
Free agents and re-signing players are signing unrealistic, long-term contract deals.
Players can submit the top contract offer for a Free Agent and still lose them to competing teams.
Contract negotiation options force players to add extra contract years or inflate signing bonuses.
CPU teams accumulate massive salary cap deficits and fail to recover in future seasons.
CPU teams repeatedly restructure large contracts during offseasons, severely compounding future salary cap issues.
CPU team rosters carry an unrealistic lack of depth at specific positions.
CPU teams only execute draft trades when players simulate the NFL draft rather than watching live picks.
CPU delegation logic automatically re-signs players for user teams even when the setting is turned off.
Fixed an issue where quitting a Showdown 1v1 game during an Extra Point could cause the game to crash.
Improved stability throughout Superstar when creating and confirming your Avatar, including navigating appearance, gear, uniform, and attribute customization.
Improved stability when purchasing and equipping gear in Superstar.
Improved stability when entering and exiting Superstar, progressing through contract signing, and navigating the Superstar Center.
Improved stability when starting Franchise Superstar games and moving through related pre-game flows.
Improved stability during post-game flows and when advancing through Superstar.
Additional stability improvements have been made across Superstar and Showdown menus to reduce instances where players could become stuck or unable to continue.
We’re continuing to focus on Superstar stability in our next update. The team is currently working through additional fixes targeting rare crashes and Storefront transaction issues.
We are investigating an issue where a server error can occur in the Superstar Storefront after purchasing a recommended Points bundle while attempting to complete another bundle purchase.
Additional Superstar stability work is underway to address a rare front-end crash.
We want to highlight a couple of targeted fixes coming in a Title Update next week based directly on your feedback. Here is what you can look forward to in the upcoming update:

Offline Franchise Halftime Fix: For those of you who love matching up in local 1v1 battles within an Offline Franchise, we have resolved an issue where the Halftime Report would softlock at the end of the segment. You will now be able to transition smoothly back to the second-half action without interruption.

Custom Adjustments Navigation Improvement: We fixed an issue that prevented the list from wrapping around, meaning you can now press "Up" at the very top of the list to quickly jump straight to the bottom item.
See disclaimers for details. Stay in the conversation by following us on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, and Answers HQ.
